subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action upgrades be approved for the secret-bearing and security-owned workflows after the Codex dependency check and final CI complete?
rationale: These are mechanically correct immutable pin updates, but several changed actions execute with credentials, write access, release authority, or security-scanning authority, and CODEOWNERS assigns affected workflows to the security team.

options.title: Approve the grouped update
options.body: Complete the sibling Codex check, obtain secops approval, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped immutable-pin update after required checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, Docker-login, and CodeQL changes into narrower PRs if the security review cannot confidently approve the grouped update.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped update
recommendation.body: Complete the sibling Codex check, obtain secops approval, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped immutable-pin update after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNERS reviewer for multiple security-sensitive workflows changed by the PR.
